artifact_scope: G3 post-V1 safe-learning identifiability and side-information evidence

target_only_credible.interpretation: strict target-only credible gating remains in cold-start lockout

exact_shared_sentinel.boundary: near the exact safety threshold, credible gating may remain conservative or admit rare finite-sample false-safe exposures

optimistic_misspecification.interpretation: a sentinel that is safer than the target can catastrophically understate target risk

pessimistic_misspecification.interpretation: a riskier sentinel preserves or recreates conservative lockout

decision: G3 is an identifiability/assumption result, not a solved safe-learning method. Side information breaks the deadlock only under a defensible transfer/exchangeability assumption; risk budgets are an alternative that explicitly pays exposure risk.
claim_boundary: no claim that sentinel transfer is robust to model mismatch
